Median per-step Physics time (ms) across repeats, lower is better
Simulates a gravity-supported 16,206-cube square stepped pyramid on a floor, holds it for two measured seconds, then launches four medium
spheres into its front base at 60 Hz
Headless, no-graphics run; Windows x64 release files; 5 repeats; threads 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 24; 600 measured steps + 0 warmup;
Micro-Star International Co., Ltd. PRO Z790-A WIFI (MS-7E07) BIOS A.E0; Microsoft Windows 11 Pro for Workstations 64-bit 10.0.26200
